title: None salt breaks legacy signer/serializer behavior
issue: Passing salt=None to Signer or Serializer breaks signing and serialization, although it worked in the previous release. Restore support for explicit None with legacy-compatible signatures: it should use the signer default, which can differ from the default when the serializer salt argument is omitted. Preserve explicit empty and nonempty string/bytes salts and key rotation. Public regression tests reproduce failures in both classes.
public_test_origin: Two harness-authored public reproductions based on issue #237; upstream fix has no test diff
